note: every number of this board the tools on the computer use (convert.py, check.py, src/tools/assets.py, stream.py); another board: its own board.json in its folder, and custom_board in platformio.ini; every output records the name and a hash of the values (notes left out): a change converts them again
name: Arduino UNO (ATmega328P, 16 MHz)

flash.note: program flash (32 KB minus the 512-byte bootloader); how constants are kept there: the attribute after every array and the header that defines it ('' = none, for boards whose constants stay in flash); bytes read a cycle count by readFlash8 (pgm_read_byte)

serial.note: Uno::UnoSerial over the USB chip, used by stream.py: the default baud, the USB vendor ids that find the board (Arduino x2, WCH CH340, FTDI, Silicon Labs CP210x, Prolific PL2303), what a stream keeps up with (measured: 16000 is at the edge)

screenBus.note: Uno::UnoST7789 (8 MHz SPI), cycles counted from the avr-gcc output of Window::fillWindow(): a window (call + clip + CASET / RASET / RAMWR), a pixel (2 SPI bytes), a run of the video decoder; a segment and a pixel of image::Decoder (decoding included)

tone.note: Uno::UnoTone: the frequencies a square wave can have

pcmOut.note: Uno::UnoPcmOut: the sample clock is whole ticks (at most maxTicks) of Timer2 at one of clocksHz, tried in order; the rates convert.py takes; above recommendedMaxRate the interrupt takes much of the CPU
